title: Chinese Hanfu Portrait (Jimeng)
description: Traditional Chinese hanfu portrait using Jimeng AI. Perfect for Chinese cultural content, hanfu photography, and Asian history blogs.

explained.why: Jimeng (鍗虫ⅵ) by ByteDance understands Chinese aesthetics deeply.
鍙ら (ancient style) preset renders traditional Chinese aesthetics.

tutorial.intro: Jimeng (鍗虫ⅵ) is built by ByteDance specifically for Chinese aesthetics. Use Chinese phrases + named historical periods.
steps: Format: 鍙ら姹夋湇缇庡コ鑲栧儚 鈥?Chinese phrase + hanfu context.
Outfit: 绾㈣壊涓濈桓姹夋湇 鈥?specific color + material.
Hair: 绮捐嚧鍙戦閰嶉噾鑹叉鎽?鈥?traditional hair + accessory.
Background: 姹熷崡搴櫌鑳屾櫙 鈥?Jiangnan garden = traditional setting.
Prop: 鎵嬫寔鍥㈡墖 鈥?holding a fan = classical pose.
Style: 宸ョ瑪閲嶅僵椋庢牸锛屾按澧ㄦ檿鏌撹儗鏅?鈥?gongbi painting style + ink wash background.
tutorial.tips: Jimeng loves Chinese cultural keywords: 宸ョ瑪 (gongbi), 鍐欐剰 (xieyi), 姘村ⅷ (ink wash), 姹熷崡 (Jiangnan). Use them freely.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "chinese hanfu portrait, red silk, jiangnan garden --ar 2:3 --v 6.1 --s 800".
crossModel.stable_diffusion: SDXL + Dreamshaper with Chinese LoRA. Jimeng is best for Chinese style.
crossModel.flux: Flux is OK for general Chinese aesthetic but Jimeng is best for traditional.
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3: "A traditional Chinese hanfu portrait of a woman in red silk, Jiangnan garden background, holding a fan, gongbi painting style".

faq.q: Why does my Chinese portrait look generic Asian?
faq.a: You forgot the specific era + named setting (Jiangnan) + traditional prop (fan). Specificity = authenticity.

faq.q: How to make it look like a painting?
faq.a: Use "宸ョ瑪閲嶅僵" (gongbi) or "姘村ⅷ" (ink wash). These are the two main Chinese painting styles.
Jimeng with 鍙ら preset + Jiangnan/silk references. Reads as "Chinese culture" instantly.
